g.text: US-15: Workspace Restore - Returning Operator Resumes Scoped Stream
If the operator's Google session is still valid,
Google issues a new ID token without a popup.
JWT is stored in memory only - not localStorage,
not a cookie. It lives for the browser session.
On tab close, the operator re-authenticates on
next open (Google silent auth makes this seamless).
SELECT scope FROM user_workspaces WHERE user_id = $1
Scope is loaded into the in-memory connection map.
Only alerts matching this scope will be pushed.
The operator receives alerts from the moment the
connection opens - no replay of missed alerts.
exact same view as previous session
